claim_tested: MRX20 is a mitochondrial carrier family member
key_finding: Sequence survey assigning all 35 yeast MCF proteins; YFR045W resequenced to 285 aa; source of the SGD ISS for GO:0006839 and GO:0005743
confidence_and_limitations: Medium. No transport assay; ISS only

claim_tested: GO:0071913 and GO:0006843 citrate terms are justified
key_finding: Both citrate terms on P43617 are IBA only, propagated from the SLC25A1 orthology group plus yeast CTP1 (S000000495); no experimental evidence on MRX20
confidence_and_limitations: High for the provenance claim. The annotation is family-level, not gene-level

claim_tested: MRX20 has a known molecular function
key_finding: SGD independently records molecular_function with evidence code ND, in direct conflict with the GO_Central IBA citrate transporter activity
confidence_and_limitations: High. Shows curator disagreement inside GO itself

key_finding: BioID proximity labelling scores MRX20 next to CBP3, MBA1, MRP20, MRPL4, MRPL15, MSS51 and OXA1; the paper names the gene MRX20
confidence_and_limitations: High for location, zero for substrate

claim_tested: MRX20 sits in the inner membrane
key_finding: Affinity capture MS recovers COX20 and TIM23 with MRX20
confidence_and_limitations: Medium. Co-purification does not define substrate

claim_tested: MRX20 mRNA is part of the mitochondrial regulon
key_finding: Puf3 binds the MRX20 3' UTR, the signature of nuclear-encoded mitochondrial mRNAs

claim_tested: Loss of MRX20 produces a substrate-diagnostic phenotype
key_finding: All curated phenotypes come from large-scale surveys and are mild: viable, decreased competitive fitness, decreased valinomycin and nickel resistance, slower proline utilization, abnormal vacuole morphology in NaCl
confidence_and_limitations: Medium. No growth defect on any carbon source that would implicate citrate transport

claim_tested: Contact point residues identified by the geometric scan are functionally real
key_finding: Mutagenesis of CTP1 shows R181, R276 and R279 are required for citrate transport; the scan returns exactly these three for CTP1
context: S. cerevisiae CTP1 reconstituted in liposomes
confidence_and_limitations: High as a method control, indirect for MRX20

claim_tested: Substrate specificity is encoded at contact points I, II and III on H2, H4 and H6
key_finding: Robinson and Kunji define the three-contact-point framework. Full text could not be fetched programmatically (Europe PMC fullTextXML HTTP 500, PMC article pages returned stubs), so contact points were defined geometrically here and validated on AAC2 and CTP1
context: Bovine AAC1 structure plus MCF-wide sequence analysis
confidence_and_limitations: High for the framework; the specific residue list was not readable, stated as a limitation

citation: This work, structural analysis of AF-P43617-F1-v4
claim_tested: MRX20 is a structurally competent carrier
key_finding: Three intact matrix salt bridges: E30-K124 2.81 A, E121-K243 2.64 A, D240-K33 4.23 A, comparable to CTP1 and SFC1; cavity net charge +3, same as CTP1

citation: This work, contact point scan over 30 AlphaFold models
claim_tested: MRX20 carries the citrate-type contact point II
key_finding: MRX20 has R193-Q194-x-x-N197, matching CTP1 R181-Q182-x-x-N185 and SFC1 R184-Q185-x-x-N188, but Gln201 at +8 where all three tricarboxylate carriers have Arg (Fisher one-sided p = 0.0059, permutation p = 0.0066, 27/27 parameter settings, pLDDT 89)
confidence_and_limitations: Medium. n = 3 tricarboxylate carriers limits power

citation: This work, leave-one-out 1-NN on the contact point II motif
claim_tested: The motif can assign substrate class, and what it assigns to MRX20
key_finding: LOO accuracy 9/11 (baseline 0.45, binomial p = 0.016); MRX20 RQNQ scores 17 to CTP1 and YHM2, 16 to SFC1, 0-1 to all three oxodicarboxylate carriers; its single error, SFC1 called tricarboxylate, is the exact axis on which MRX20 is intermediate
confidence_and_limitations: Medium. Small panel; classifier cannot separate citrate from succinate/fumarate

claim_tested: The reference 309-aa S288C translation is correct
key_finding: Four Saccharomyces orthologs (J8PP08, J8TXW4, H0GFS1, A0A6C1DQS1) are all 285 aa and start at the residue aligned to S288C Met25; Belenkiy et al. also reported 285 aa
confidence_and_limitations: Medium. Sequence-feature issue only; contact points lie downstream

claim_tested: PANTHER subfamily membership justifies the citrate call
key_finding: PTHR45788 contains only three reviewed yeast proteins: CTP1 (citrate), SFC1 (succinate/fumarate) and MRX20. The family spans two substrate classes, so family-level propagation cannot pick one
confidence_and_limitations: High. Directly undercuts the IBA rationale

citation: This work, all-vs-all identity over 34 yeast PF00153 carriers
claim_tested: MRX20 is a close CTP1 paralog
key_finding: Closest yeast carrier to MRX20 is CTP1 at 33.8% identity (family median 23.1%, 94.8th percentile), far below the 64.7-89.3% seen for yeast carrier pairs sharing a substrate
confidence_and_limitations: High. Identity alone cannot transfer substrate at 34%
